hypothesis: 原29字段个股模型的训练损失类别不平衡可能造成正例漏判；用训练期加权类别平衡检验，不能用召回增加代替Accuracy改善
baseline: reuse immutable BASE saved predictions; no refit or re-selection
challenge: same pipeline and 29 fields; class_weight[c]=W/(2*Wc), where Wc=sum(original inverse-date-cohort training weights for class c); all weights computed only from original same training members
training: last252 original known-label signal dates; both signal and exact official target strictly before each fixed fold start; original median imputation, indicators, scaling and daily inverse-count weights unchanged

secondary: true OHLC non-one-word rank-first promotion rate
raw score diagnostic squared loss, not probability Brier

historical_screen: all three folds Accuracy improve >=.03, full positive Recall/F1/coverage not down; true nonword top1 not down when source identity is known. Any failure rejects this fixed challenge for future use; no retuning
production_upgrade: historical screen never grants upgrade; old source-bound120 official-day gate, complete-pool guard and real author review still required; existing three-arm/G1 protocols unchanged
one_attempt: fit each fold once; nonconvergence/unknown inputs retained and stop challenger; no alternative weighting or threshold search
expected_effect: test Recall improvement against possible Precision/Accuracy loss; no guaranteed gain
scope: already-inspected retrospective diagnosis; no theme-PIT or new collection; target Oct9 not mature
